headline: OpenAI offers GPT-6 Astra’s weights as GPT-Rosalind-6 for screened life-sciences research
summary: OpenAI’s Oct 30 system-card addendum says GPT-Rosalind-6 uses GPT-6 Astra’s weights without additional training or post-training. OpenAI’s release and setup notes say GPT-6 Rosalind Research is rolling out to limited approved Research organizations in Work and Codex, and through separately approved API access; it is not available in Chat. Enterprise workspaces begin with a two-week Admin Preview with access off by default. At the highest reasoning budget tested, OpenAI reports higher GPT-Rosalind-6 scores than GPT-Rosalind-5.5 on three shared benchmark sets: MedChemBench v7 (49.6% vs 28.9%, 99 problems), GeneBench Pro v13 single-attempt success (37.7% vs 16.7%, 129 problems), and LifeSciBench Gold (61.3% vs 44.0%, 94 of 100 problems after excluding six flagged tasks). OpenAI classifies biological capability as High but below Critical on its selected Preparedness evaluations. These are first-party results; GeneBench used a configuration unlike production, the Critical thresholds are preliminary, and no independent reproduction or real-world productivity/safety outcome is established.
